events.title: Japan Stock Market May See Renewed Consolidation On Monday
events.description: The Japan stock market on Friday ended the six-day losing streak in which it had tumbled more than 6,240 points or 9.1 percent. The Nikkei now sits just above the 65,320-point plateau although it may turn lower again on Monday.

events.title: KOSPI May Hand Back Friday's Gains
events.description: The South Korea stock market on Friday snapped the brutal seven-day losing streak in which it had crashed more than 1,450 points or 22.5 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,670-point plateau although it may head south again on Monday.

events.title: New Zealand Performance Of Services Index Ebbs In September - BusinessNZ
events.description: The services sector in New Zealand continued to expand in September, albeit at a slightly slower rate, the latest survey from BusinessNZ revealed on Monday with a Performance of Services score of 50.9.

events.title: China Data Due On Monday
events.description: China is scheduled to release a raft of data on Monday, highlighting a busy day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. On tap are Q3 figures for gross domestic product and September numbers for industrial production, retail sales, fixed asset investment, house prices and unemployment.

events.title: New Zealand Has NZ$1.971 Billion Trade Shortfall
events.description: New Zealand posted a merchandise trade deficit of NZ$1.971 billion in September, the New Zealand Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.

events.title: TSX Pares Early Gains; Energy Stocks Stay Firm
events.description: After opening marginally higher and moving further up fairly swiftly Friday morning, Canadian stocks slid gradually and slipped into negative territory, weighed down by losses in technology sector. Strong buying in energy and consumer staples sectors help limit market's downside.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Higher Again
events.description:
The Switzerland market extended its gains to a sixth straight session even as stocks swung between gains and losses for most part of the trading day on Friday. 

The market tracked gains in other markets across Europe amid easing concerns about interest rates and AI-related investments.

events.title: European Equities Close Higher On AI Optimism
events.description: European equities closed higher Friday as easing rate concerns and AI investments boosted sentiment. Defense stocks rallied amid European leaders' Ukraine support. Stoxx 600 gained 0.72%, with DAX up 0.95% and FTSE 100 up 0.38%.

events.title: U.S. Industrial Production Climbs More Than Expected In September
events.description: A report released by the Federal Reserve on Friday showed industrial production in the U.S. increased by more than expected in the month of September. The Fed said industrial production climbed by 0.7 percent in September following a revised 0.1 percent uptick in August.

events.title: U.S. Import, Export Prices Jump Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: Import and export prices in the U.S. both increased by far more than anticipated in the month of September, according to a report released by the Labor Department on Friday.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open With Positive Bias
events.description: Canadian stocks may open with a positive bias Friday morning with materials stocks likely to move higher on firm precious metals prices.

events.title: FTSE 100 Up Slightly At Noon In Cautious Trade
events.description: The U.K. market's benchmark index FTSE 100 was marginally above the flat line a few minutes past noon on Friday as stocks recovered from a weak start thanks to support at lower levels. Potential tax hike on banks weighed on sentiment at the start.

events.title: Indian Shares Close Higher As IT Stocks Extend Surge
events.description: Indian shares eked out modest gains on Friday, adding to sharp gains in the previous session as information technology stocks extended recent gains following encouraging Q2 earnings from Wipro and Tech Mahindra.
